titre: Manzon Allah SAW ya kasance idan yayi Al-wala yakan kwaranya ruwa akan Damatsensa
hadith: Daga Jabir Allah ya yarda da shi ya ce: Manzon Allah SAW ya kasance idan yayi Al-wala yakan kwaranya ruwa akan Damatsensa
attribution: Al-Baihaki ne Ya Rawaito shi - Al-Dar Al-Kutni Ya Rawaito shi
explication: Hadisin yana bayanin cewa yana daga cikin Farillan Alwala wanke Hannaye zuwa tsintsiyar Hannu, da kuma qarfafawa kan game guiwar hannu yana cikinsu a wajen wanke hannaye
ar: عن جابر بن عبد الله رضي الله عنهما قال: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا توضأ أدار الماء على مِرْفَقَيْهِ.
